remarks: Welcome to 1420 Yorkshire Lane, a rare opportunity to own in the sought-after Sunny Hills Village community of La Habra. Tucked toward the rear of the community and facing a greenbelt, this home offers a peaceful setting while remaining close to the shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences that make this location so desirable. This two-story residence features 2 bedrooms, 1.5 bathrooms, approximately 1,082 square feet of living space, an attached two-car garage, private patio, central air, and convenient laundry hookups in the garage.
